nodes.name: find_checkpoint
nodes.summary: Selects checkpoint with lowest val_loss from logs/checkpoints/ by parsing filename val_loss= token.

nodes.name: generate_visualizations
nodes.summary: Loads best checkpoint, runs test inference, produces scatter, residuals, time-series, variable importance, lag-correlation, and shock-detection plots under results/.

nodes.name: test_pipeline.py
nodes.summary: End-to-end pipeline test (no retraining): validates src imports, SPEI thresholds, processed dataset schema/integrity/splits, TimeSeriesDataSet creation, model loading + inference metrics, and evaluate.py end-to-end run.

nodes.name: _is_schema_v2
nodes.summary: Returns True if parquet exists and its schema_version column unique set == [2].

nodes.name: _resolve_processed_data_path
nodes.summary: Prefers data/processed/spei_dataset.parquet, falls back to results/smoke_v2/processed_schema_v2.parquet.

nodes.name: _resolve_checkpoint_path
nodes.summary: Resolves checkpoint from run_config.json -> smoke_report.json -> lowest val_loss in logs/checkpoints/.

tour.title: 1. Research Overview & Domain Documentation
tour.description: Explore the project documentation detailing Temporal Fusion Transformer (TFT) applied to SPEI drought index forecasting across Indonesian regencies.

tour.title: 2. Data Ingestion & SPEI Drought Calculation
tour.description: Understand how raw meteorological variables (OpenMeteo SDK) are ingested, converted into SPEI drought scale, and preprocessed into regular time-series arrays.

tour.title: 3. Temporal Fusion Transformer Architecture
tour.description: Examine the PyTorch Forecasting TFT network model wrapper, custom TimeSeriesDataSet construction, and static/dynamic covariate definitions.

tour.title: 4. Model Training & Experiment Execution
tour.description: Trace the PyTorch Lightning trainer configuration, multi-horizon loss minimization, learning rate optimization, and training entry point.

tour.title: 5. Multi-Horizon Evaluation & Calibration
tour.description: Inspect evaluation metrics (Quantile Loss, RMSE, MAE), prediction calibration checks, and full multi-seed evaluation runners.

tour.title: 6. Prediction Visualization & Map Generation
tour.description: View scripts that plot predicted vs actual SPEI time-series and generate spatial Leaflet/Cartopy map grids of drought severity.

tour.title: 7. Static Code Audit & End-to-End Pipeline QA
tour.description: Review the custom Sonar code audit runner and end-to-end smoke test script ensuring pipeline integrity.
